info.title: Telnyx Number Lookup (official subset)
info.description: Closed subset of the official Telnyx OpenAPI specification (https://github.com/team-telnyx/openapi openapi/spec3.json), limited to GET /number_lookup/{phone_number} and the components it references. Schemas are copied verbatim from the official spec; they are not hand-written.

get.description: Returns information about the provided phone number.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation of the error.

pointer.description: JSON pointer (RFC6901) to the offending entity.

parameter.description: Indicates which query parameter caused the error.

example.title: Invalid street address
example.description: The street address provided is invalid.

country_code.description: Region code that matches the specific country calling code

national_format.description: Hyphen-separated national number, preceded by the national destination code (NDC), with a 0 prefix, if an NDC is found

nnid_override.description: Network number ID (NNID) override for the phone number, when one applies (available only to accounts enabled for NNID); otherwise null.

valid_number.description: Indicates whether the phone number is valid.

CallerIdentity.description: Identity information for the phone number's owner — name and postal address plus additional identity, line, and demographic detail. Populated when `type=caller-identity` is requested. Person-only fields (name parts, demographics) are null for a business.

name.description: The name associated with the phone number.

confidence_score.description: How strongly the phone number is linked to the returned name, on a scale of 50 to 90 (higher means more supporting signals). Reflects signal strength, not probability: 70 indicates stronger, more consistent evidence than 60, not a 70% chance of being correct. As a guide, 70+ is high confidence, 60 moderate, and 50 limited. Below 50 no name is returned, so scores under 50 are never present.

error_code.description: A lookup-specific error code if the identity could not be resolved; otherwise null.

phone_number.description: The looked-up phone number, echoed back for request/response verification.

entity_type.description: Whether the number's owner is a `person` or a `business`. Null when not available.

first_name.description: Owner's first name. Returned for a person; null for a business.

middle_name.description: Owner's middle name. Returned for a person; null for a business.

last_name.description: Owner's last name. Returned for a person; null for a business.

alternate_names.description: Other names associated with the owner, de-duplicated. Null when not available.

industry.description: Industries associated with a business owner. Empty array when none; null on a failed lookup.

entity_linked_since.description: Approximate date the owner was first associated with this phone number, if available. Null when not available.

is_valid.description: The identity data source's view of whether the number is valid. May differ from the top-level `valid_number`, which comes from LRN data. Null when not available.

country_calling_code.description: The number's country calling (dial) code. Null when not available.

line_type.description: The identity data source's view of the line type, at finer granularity than `portability.line_type`. May disagree with `portability.*`, which comes from LRN data. Null when not available.

carrier.description: The identity data source's view of the carrier. May differ from the LRN-derived carrier data. Null when not available.

is_prepaid.description: Whether the line is prepaid. Null when not available.

is_commercial.description: Whether the line is commercial (a business indicator). Null when not available.

warnings.description: Warnings about the request, as Telnyx-owned codes. Null or empty when there are none.

demographics.description: Demographic detail for a person owner. Present on a successful lookup; its fields are null for a business.

age_range.description: Owner's approximate age range. Null for a business or when not available.

gender.description: Owner's gender as provided by the identity data source. Null for a business or when not available.

number-lookup_Address.description: Postal address associated with the phone number's owner.

street_line_1.description: First line of the street address.

street_line_2.description: Second line of the street address, if any.

location_type.description: Classification of the address, for example `Address` or `ZipPlus4`. Null when not available.

delivery_point.description: Delivery-point classification of the address, for example `SingleUnit`, `MultiUnit`, `POBox`, or `PartialAddress`. Null when not available.

is_active.description: Whether the address is currently active for the owner. Null when not available.

entity_linked_since.description: Approximate date the owner was first associated with this address, if available. Null when not available.

lrn.description: Local Routing Number, if assigned to the requested phone number

ported_status.description: Indicates whether or not the requested phone number has been ported

ported_date.description: ISO-formatted date when the requested phone number has been ported

ocn.description: Operating Company Name (OCN) as per the Local Exchange Routing Guide (LERG) database

line_type.description: The line type of the phone number. Uses the same value set as carrier.type; see the API reference for the full list.

altspid.description: Alternative SPID (Service Provider ID). Often used when a carrier is using a number from another carrier

city.description: City name extracted from the locality in the Local Exchange Routing Guide (LERG) database

EnhancedCallerName.description: Enhanced caller name for the phone number's owner. Populated when `type=enhanced-caller-name` is requested.

caller_name.description: The name associated with the phone number.

entity_type.description: The entity type of the phone number's owner, from the enhanced caller name data source — `Person` or `Business`. Null when not available.

error_code.description: A lookup-specific error code if the enhanced caller name could not be resolved; otherwise null.

caller_name.description: The name of the requested phone number's owner as per the CNAM database

error_code.description: A caller-name lookup specific error code, expressed as a stringified 5-digit integer

mobile_country_code.description: Region code that matches the specific country calling code if the requested phone number type is mobile

mobile_network_code.description: National destination code (NDC), with a 0 prefix, if an NDC is found and the requested phone number type is mobile

name.description: SPID (Service Provider ID) name, if the requested phone number has been ported; otherwise, the name of carrier who owns the phone number block

type.description: A phone number type that identifies the type of service associated with the requested phone number

normalized_carrier.description: If known to Telnyx and applicable, the primary network carrier.

PhoneNumber.name: phone_number
PhoneNumber.description: The phone number to be looked up

NumberLookupType.name: type
NumberLookupType.description: Specifies the type of number lookup to be performed. May be supplied more than once to request several data sources in a single call (for example, `?type=carrier&type=enhanced-caller-name`). Each requested type populates the corresponding object in the response.

number-lookup_UnprocessableEntity.description: Unprocessable entity. Check the 'detail' field in response for details.

errors.title: Unprocessable Entity
errors.detail: The server understood the syntax of the request but was unable to process the instructions.
